# Architecture (from the agreed sketch)

> No separate architecture step: the work is S with low risk, and the owner agreed on sketch v1. Build what the sketch shows, properly.

## Stack
- Node.js 26.7 (node:http, node:sqlite — both built in)
- TypeScript 7.0.2 (type-check only, Node runs the .ts files directly)
- Plain HTML/CSS/JS page, no framework

## How to run
npm install, then npm start, open http://localhost:8080 (the second design direction is at http://localhost:8080/_alt). Needs Node 24+ for the built-in SQLite; you are on 26.7.

## Verify commands (as the sketch found them)
- `npm run typecheck`
- `npm start`

## What the sketch showed
A working URL shortener you can run right now: POST a URL and get a short code, open the code and it redirects with a 302 while counting the click, and one page lists every link with its open count. It uses Node's built-in SQLite and HTTP server, so there are no runtime dependencies at all. The web page comes in two looks to choose from: a dark dense table ('tool') and a light card list with a form hero on top ('friendly'). Everything in the screenshots is real data from the real API, not mock-ups.

### Real in the sketch
- Shorten, redirect and stats all work end to end against a real SQLite file
- Short codes are 7 random characters from crypto.getRandomValues over a 56-char alphabet with look-alikes (0/O/1/l/I) removed, so links are not enumerable
- Every open is stored as its own row with a timestamp, so counts and 'last open' are computed, not stored counters
- URL validation (http/https only), alias rules (3-32 chars, reserved words blocked), 409 on a taken alias
- Both page designs are the real HTML/CSS, fed by the real /api/links endpoint
- Zero runtime dependencies: node:sqlite and node:http are built into Node 26

### Faked in the sketch (must be built for real)
- The five links in the screenshots were seeded by hand and the opens were generated with a curl loop
- Both design directions are served by the same app for comparison (/ and /_alt); the real build keeps only the one you pick and drops the other file and its route
- Copy-to-clipboard works in the browser but is not wired to any feedback beyond the button label
- No delete, no edit, no pagination on the link list; the real build should decide whether it needs them
- No tests were written, per the sketch rules; the brief asks for full test coverage and the real build must add it

## Sketch code
Branch `orys/sketch`; the files it changed are copied to `.orys/sketch/code/` for reference. It cuts corners: rebuild properly, reuse what is sound.
